about.description: TBT is a bond fund perpetual listed on BingX, tracking ProShares UltraShort 20+ Year Treasury, margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
